extensionDescription.message: Rewrite, summarize and ask questions about your mail with Claude.

errorHostNotFound.message: The helper service is not installed. Please run "npm run host:install".

errorCliNotFound.message: Claude Code was not found. Please install it and run "npm run host:install" again.

errorNotLoggedIn.message: Claude Code is not logged in. Please start "claude" in a terminal and log in.

errorRateLimited.message: The usage limit has been reached. Please try again later.

errorTimeout.message: The request took too long and was stopped.

composeScopeBody.message: Your own text outside quote and signature (first block)

composeProtected.message: The selection contains a quote or signature and cannot be edited. Please select only your own text.

composeEmpty.message: No text of your own yet. Please write or select some text.

composeStale.message: The text has changed in the meantime, please start again.

composeScopeInsert.message: No text of your own yet. A draft will be inserted above the quote.

composeOriginalFailed.message: The original message could not be read; draft without it.

composeTooLong.message: The text is too long (more than $MAX$ characters). Please select a shorter passage.

composeDraftPlaceholder.message: Write new text, e.g. "Ask for a meeting next week"

composeDraftLabel.message: The text is empty: the instruction writes a new draft.

displaySelectOne.message: Please display exactly one message to read it.

displayOmitted.message: Thread shortened: $COUNT$ older messages left out.

displayShortened.message: Text shortened: parts of the messages were cut to fit the size limit.

displayOmittedShortened.message: Thread shortened: $COUNT$ older messages left out, text also shortened.

displayReplyOpened.message: Reply window opened. The draft starts as soon as you click Mail Assistant there.

displayReplyFailed.message: The reply window could not be opened. For messages opened from a file, use the normal Reply button and click Mail Assistant there.

composeReplyNoBasis.message: The original message could not be read and there are no keywords. Add keywords or try again.

displayQuestionTooLong.message: The question is too long (more than $MAX$ characters). Please shorten it.

chatIntro.message: Your question is turned into search terms and the best matching emails are sent to Claude. References like [1] open the email.

chatAskPlaceholder.message: Question about your mailbox, e.g. What did Anna write about the offer?

chatMaxLabel.message: At most this many emails per question to the model:

chatNoResults.message: No matching emails found, not even with a looser search. Try other terms, a name or a time span.

chatOpenFailed.message: The email could not be opened. It may have been moved or deleted.

chatDisconnected.message: The connection to the background script was lost and the conversation so far is gone. New questions work again.

chatSent.message: $SENT$ of $FOUND$ matching emails were sent to the model.

chatSentMore.message: $SENT$ of at least $FOUND$ matching emails were sent to the model (search stopped at the limit).

chatSearchFallback.message: (words of the question, search terms could not be determined)

chatSearchRelaxed.message: (looser search, the first one found nothing)

consentIntro.message: Mail Assistant sends email content to an AI model whenever you start an action. Please take a moment to read what happens.

consentWhat.message: What is sent: the text you are working on and the email concerned, with sender, subject, date, text and the names of attachments. When reading, earlier emails of the same conversation are added; for a mailbox question, the emails found (at most as many as set in the settings).

consentWhere.message: Where it goes: through Claude Code installed on this computer to Anthropic, under your Claude account. The terms and privacy rules of your Anthropic account apply there.

consentNoAction.message: Nothing happens without your click. The add-on never sends, deletes or moves an email by itself; results are only applied when you choose to.

consentNoDisk.message: Email content and results are kept in memory only and never written to disk. Only your settings and this consent are stored.

consentRevoke.message: You can withdraw your consent at any time in the add-on settings.

consentDeclined.message: Without your consent Mail Assistant stays locked.

errorConsentRequired.message: Without your consent nothing is sent to the model.
